title: DATESWTD over a calendar, with only an untagged column filtered, is the whole week of the last visible date
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "first", MINX ( DATESWTD ( Weekly ), 'Date'[Date] ), "last", MAXX ( DATESWTD ( Weekly ), 'Date'[Date] ), "days", COUNTROWS ( DATESWTD ( Weekly ) ) ), 'Date'[DateKey] >= 20080801, 'Date'[DateKey] <= 20080813 )

source.quote: with a filter on the DateKey column from August 1 to August 13, 2008, DATESWTD ( ‘Weekly 445’ ) returns all the days from August 10 to August 16, 2008
source.supports: the same filter and the same weeks (W33-2008 is August 10 to 16)

derivation: The last visible date is 2008-08-13, in W33-2008 (Sunday August 10 to Saturday August 16): 7 days.
